protocol.candidate_average: uniform average over all accepted candidates within each parent, then equal parent weight (a specified sensitivity estimand, not a random population)
protocol.choice_envelope: min/max per parent across eligible controls computed retrospectively from outcomes; NOT a legitimate performance-optimized selector
protocol.control_pool: 87 distinct eligible controls, including the 55 historical first accepted and 32 additional from exp133; selection precedes all material outcomes
protocol.interpretation: same 55 parent clusters, not 87 independent controls; not an organization-specific mechanism or statistical replication
protocol.observation: ever union reaches 10 or 60 positions; recurrence certifies never after full microstate+next scheduler-phase repeat
protocol.physics: unchanged 104/108 phase0 left rotation, 60 four-bit windows
protocol.probe: 30 fixed raw material inputs per parent and each accepted control, both boundaries raw1..15
protocol.same_cohort: 55 G0 parents with exact on-cycle support/period/phase0 occupancy matching in up to 100 attempts
